Class OrderController

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.controller.OrderController
public class OrderController extends Object
Handles order-related API calls coming from the network layer.

This controller is a thin routing/adaptation layer between incoming Message objects and the OrderService business logic. Each handler method:

  • extracts and validates the expected payload type from Message.getData()
  • delegates the operation to OrderService
  • wraps the result into a response Message with the appropriate API call type

Payload contract: each method expects a specific payload type in message.getData() (e.g., OrderRequest, UUID, TimeGetterRequest). Sending a different type may cause ClassCastException. If you want safer behavior, add runtime type checks and return an error Message for invalid payloads.

Singleton: implemented as a singleton to keep one controller instance and one shared OrderService instance during the server runtime.

Author:
Andrei Beloziyorove

    • createOrder

      public com.andreibel.message.Message createOrder(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Creates a new order.

      Expected payload: OrderRequest. The relevant fields are typically:

      • numberOfGuests
      • orderDateTime
      • subscriberId (optional)
      • email (optional)
      • phoneNumber (optional)

      Response: CREATE_ORDER_RESPONSE with OrderResponse on success, or CREATE_ORDER_ERROR if creation failed.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing an OrderRequest
      Returns:
      response message with the created order or an error type

    • getOrder

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getOrder(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Retrieves an order by confirmation code.

      Expected payload: UUID (confirmation code).

      Response: GET_ONE_ORDER_RESPONSE with OrderResponse on success, or GET_ONE_ORDER_ERROR if not found.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing a UUID
      Returns:
      response message containing the requested order or an error type

    • deleteOrder

      public com.andreibel.message.Message deleteOrder(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Cancels (soft-deletes) an order by confirmation code.

      Expected payload: UUID (confirmation code).

      Response: DELETE_ORDER_RESPONSE with OrderResponse on success, or DELETE_ORDER_ERROR if cancellation failed or the order was not found.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing a UUID
      Returns:
      response message containing the cancelled order or an error type

    • getAllAvailableTime

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getAllAvailableTime(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Retrieves all available reservation start times for a specific date and party size.

      Expected payload: TimeGetterRequest containing:

      • date - the requested date
      • capacity - number of guests (party size)

      Response: GET_ALL_TIMES_IN_DATE_RESPONSE with List<LocalTime> on success, or GET_ALL_TIMES_IN_DATE_ERROR if there are no available times.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing TimeGetterRequest
      Returns:
      response message containing the available times or an error type

    • lostCode

      public com.andreibel.message.Message lostCode(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Handles the "lost confirmation code" flow.

      This method supports two different payload modes:

      • If message.getData() is a String, the value is forwarded to TUI.UUID_sent(String) and the method returns null. (This looks like a debug/CLI hook.)
      • Otherwise, it expects an OrderRequest and returns matching orders via OrderService.lostConformCode(OrderRequest).

      Response: ORDER_LOST_CONFORMATION_CODE_RESPONSE with a List<OrderResponse> when matches exist, or ORDER_LOST_CONFORMATION_CODE_ERROR when none found.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing either String or OrderRequest
      Returns:
      response message with matching orders, an error message, or null (string debug mode)

    • getAllActiveOrder

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getAllActiveOrder()
      Retrieves all active orders (typically: not cancelled and not completed).

      Response: GET_ALL_ACTIVE_RESPONSE with List<OrderResponse> on success, or GET_ALL_ACTIVE_ERROR if the service returns null.

      Returns:
      response message containing active orders or an error type

    • getNowEating

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getNowEating()
      Retrieves orders for customers currently eating.

      Typically represents orders that are arrived but not completed (and not cancelled), depending on the OrderService.getCurrentEat() implementation.

      Response: GET_ALL_ARRIVED_AND_NOT_COMPLETE_RESPONSE with List<OrderResponse> on success, or GET_ALL_ARRIVED_AND_NOT_COMPLETE_ERROR if the service returns null.

      Returns:
      response message containing current eating orders or an error type
